results.title: Reader Sideload Library — organize e-ink libraries
results.h1: Organize and sideload your e-ink library.
results.audience: For e-ink reader owners who keep EPUB and PDF files, collections and highlights stay under your control.
facts: No account or background network requests
Catalogue, collection, and Markdown tools reopen offline after the first sample visit
USB and WebDAV tools are free
